requestInterpretation.userRequest: For Level 1, reproduce everything except the 3D models.
requestInterpretation.constraint: Do not copy third-party UI artwork, audio, names, exact text, or other expressive content. Reproduce the observed mechanics, camera beats, ordering, timing relationships, route pressure, and settlement flow with original presentation.

observations.visible: wide bright outdoor scene; elevated white route; several collectible food-like targets; large tap-to-jump/flip prompt
single-tap motion and repeated tapping prompt; collectibles are arranged along the route and visibly disappear when contacted
two tall colored rung/stack obstacles create a narrow upper/lower decision; camera tracks forward while the blade remains prominent
explicit spike warning; magenta spike pad appears on the route; collectibles continue beyond the warning
large checker-pattern terminal wall with stacked multiplier lanes; final targets remain visible before contact
screen dims; completion banner; score, bonus, result and best score; primary claim and rewarded claim actions; settings icon remains visible

inferences: Level 1 is a tutorialized sequence of input lesson → repeated-input cadence → route choice → hazard warning → multiplier finish → settlement.
The camera and HUD must stage the next lesson before the player reaches it; simply adding equivalent objects without the beat timing would not satisfy the evidence.
Settlement is part of the level experience and must lead to a clear replay/continue action in the target game, using original wording and UI styling.
acceptance: Natural desktop play follows the six observed beats in order and reaches settlement.
390x844 portrait preserves the same ordering, readable prompts, hazard signal and finish choice.
Finish settlement exposes score/result/best/replay or continue controls without hiding the terminal wall before selection.
All presented art, labels, colors and audio remain original to the target game.
